app.name: MelonARC
lang.label: Language
core.offline.title: The core is not reachable
core.offline.body: The window reads the core over a loopback address only, so there is nothing to show while the core is not running. Start it and this view recovers on its own; the window does not need to be reopened.
core.auth.title: The core rejected the token
core.auth.body: The token file exists but the core does not accept it. The core rotates its token on every start, so the file most likely comes from an earlier run. Restarting the core fixes it.
core.nobridge.title: No channel to the core
core.nobridge.body: This page was not opened through the desktop shell or the local preview server, so it cannot read the core.
overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Core status, listener addresses and the current outbound
overview.supervision.note: Reported by the shell: the process it starts and watches. This is not the API answer above.
overview.supervision.restart.failed: The core could not be restarted
overview.supervision.stopped: The shell did not start the core
overview.supervision.crashed: The core kept failing and is no longer restarted

rules.sets.empty: No external rule set is configured
rules.sets.note: The local API exposes only the name and path of a rule set; entry counts and refresh times are not part of it.

rules.test.label: Name or IP address

rules.test.hint: Uses the core's existing rule explanation to show the matched rule and the decision path; the configuration is not changed.
rules.test.network.label: Network
rules.test.needed: Enter a name or an IP address first.

logs.subtitle: Audit trail and connection failures

logs.audit.empty: No audit entry has been recorded
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Shell settings, language and about
settings.field.datadir.hint: Leave empty for the default data directory. The shell applies it on the next start.
settings.field.api.hint: Only a loopback host and port is accepted. The shell applies it on the next start.
settings.field.corepath.hint: Leave empty to look next to the shell first, then on PATH. Takes effect after a core restart.
settings.field.coreconfig.hint: Leave empty for <data directory>/melonarc.conf. Takes effect after a core restart.
settings.priority: MELONARC_DATA_DIR and MELONARC_API_ADDR win over this file, and the file wins over the defaults.
settings.restart_required: Restart the application to apply this
settings.restart_required.body: The shell reads the data directory and the API address once, at start-up. Restart the application after saving; the core does not need a restart.
settings.core.restart.hint: The core path and configuration are read the next time the core starts.
settings.core.restart.failed: The core could not be restarted
settings.unavailable.title: No shell is attached
settings.unavailable.body: These values live in the desktop shell's settings file, and this channel cannot read it, so nothing can be saved here.
settings.error.address: The API address must be a loopback host and port, for example 127.0.0.1:7946.
settings.error.datadir: The data directory must not contain control characters.
settings.error.corepath: The core binary path must not contain control characters.
settings.error.coreconfig: The core configuration path must not contain control characters.
settings.error.write: The settings file could not be written.
settings.language.label: Interface language
settings.language.hint: Switching takes effect immediately and is remembered.
settings.about.body: The mark is the final bitmap; vector redrawing and full-size exports come with the icon asset step.
error.no_bridge: The page is not connected to the core.
error.token_missing: The token file was not found; the core has probably not started yet.
error.core_unreachable: The local API of the core cannot be reached.
error.unauthorized: The core rejected the current token.
error.bad_response: The core answered with data this build does not understand.
error.api_error: The core answered with an error.
